question: As of October 2020, who is the President of Venezuela?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nicolas Maduro.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nicolás Maduro is a Venezuelan politician and president of Venezuela since 2013**, with his presidency under debate since 2019.
 
• Venezuela has **the world's largest known oil reserves and has been one of the world's leading exporters of oil**.
 
• **On 14 April 2013 Nicolás Maduro** was elected President of Venezuela, only just defeating opposition candidate **Henrique Capriles with just 1.5%** of the vote separating the two candidates.
 
• Venezuela is home to the **world's largest rodent.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2a8f369a7489131b73ffa65b9bf7c970ef96af57a93061ec896d711ae83709f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Juan Vicente Gómez Chacón **was a Venezuelan military general and ruler of Venezuela from **1908 till his death in 1935.****​ **
 
• Rómulo **Ernesto** Betancourt Bello famous as **"The Father of Venezuelan Democracy", **was the president of Venezuela.
 
• **Jose Antonio Paez** was** ****a** mestizo llanero, one of the horsemen of the plains.
